name: Triangle Heart 3 ~Lyrical Omochabako~
original_name: とらいあんぐるハート3 ～リリカルおもちゃ箱～
source:
This is our desktop accessory collection from "Love, Love Omocha Bako." This collection is loaded with even more fun stuff than our previous product. You'll find "Akira's Dynamite Hammer," a mole-hitting keyboard game, Pon, a hyper quiz game, and much, much more! We've also included an alarm clock for your desktop, wallpaper, a screensaver, and even sound drag. Your PC will once again become a very exciting part of your life!

Along with the many exciting accessories, you'll find our special mini-AVG feature, "Maho Shojo: Nanoha Lilikaru." Unlike our previous version, you will find areas where characters can be changed. Not only will you be able to change Nanoha, you'll also be able to change Momoko and Phyllis as well. It all leads up to a very captivating story! As an added bonus, we have provided multiple endings for endless hours of fun. As the story diverges outward, it becomes more difficult with each new stage. You'll never make fun of mini-AVGs again!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030225222733/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/tora3_ririkaru/]Gamelex[/url]]
